hero.caption:
Rough PNG map of the Manche Chol / Ch'ol Territory and environs in the 16th century, based on File:Maya civilization location map-blank.svg, and processed via MacOS Pages, with (1) some toponym spellings per Jones 1998 p xx map 1, and (2) most locations and some toponym spellings per Becquey 2012 maps 3, 6, 8, 10, (3) some locations per Google Maps. Note (1) hatching roughly depicts extent of the Territory in circa mid 16th cent, (2) principal settlements marked in title case, and polities in all caps, (3) all locations are very approximate. 
Cited –

Becquey, Cédric (5 December 2012). "Quelles frontières pour les populations cholanes?". Ateliers d’anthropologie (in French). 37. doi:10.4000/ateliers.9181.
Jones, Grant D. (1998). The Conquest of the Last Maya Kingdom. Stanford, California, US: Stanford University Press. ISBN 978-0-8047-3522-3.
